title: Vectors: Routing RPL/LOADng (20 missing, 4 P0)
description:
DESCRIPTION

  P0:                                                                         
                                                                              
  • dao_origin_seq_max_64bit: 0xffffffffffffffff MUST NOT wrap                
  • dao_source_route_hop_limit: Segments Left < remaining Hop Limit           
  • dao_option_order_signature_final: signature MUST be final option          
  • announce_signed_data_transcript: originator_iid||pubkey||seq_num||        
  rx_channel||app_data                                                        
                                                                              
  P1:                                                                         
                                                                              
  • dao_option_lengths_exact: Target=18, Transit=20, Origin Sig=56            
  • dao_source_route_max_hops: 8 hops accept, 9 reject                        
  • announce_hop_count_boundary: 14 relay, 15 no relay                        
  • announce_seq_num_freshness: 16-bit wrap 65535->0 fresh                    
  • gradient_timeout_expiry: 599s valid, 600s expired                         
  • loadng_rerr_generation: link failure triggers RERR                        
  • loadng_expanding_ring: hop_limit 4->8->15                                 
  • loadng_rreq_timeout_retry: 5s timeout, 3 retries                          
  • passive_learning_gradient: DATA_GRADIENT_TIMEOUT=60s                      
  • gradient_source_priority_ranking: announce/rrep/rpl beats data            
  • route_decision_fallback_order: gradient->LOADng->RPL->Yggdrasil           
                                                                              
  P2:                                                                         
                                                                              
  • dtn_expiry_timestamp_encoding, announce_congestion_app_data,              
  announce_pending_destinations, dio_dis_dao_ack_encoding,                    
  opportunistic_header_encoding                                               

## Progress

### Completed
- dao_origin_seq_max_64bit: Added valid_max_u64_sequence vector (seq=2^64-1)
- dao_option_order_signature_final: Already covered by reject_nonterminal_option

### In Progress  
- dao_source_route_hop_limit: Created source_route_hop_limit.json vectors. Implementation gap: segments_left < hop_limit validation not yet implemented in Python/Rust.
- announce_signed_data_transcript: Vector format analyzed, transcript is: iid[0..8] + pubkey + seq_num(2B BE) + rx_channel(1B) + app_data
